description: This file defines a plugin class 'TLTestPlugin' for the TestLink test management system, providing UI hooks and event handlers for test suite, project, case, requirement, and test run events.

classes.name: TLTestPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for TestLink that registers UI hooks and handles various test-related events.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Initializes plugin metadata such as name, description, version, author, contact, and URL.

methods.name: hooks
methods.description: Defines event hooks and their corresponding handler methods.

methods.name: testsuite_create
methods.description: Handles the event when a test suite is created; outputs a message and logs a warning.

methods.name: testproject_create
methods.description: Handles test project creation event; logs details.

methods.name: testproject_update
methods.description: Handles test project update event; logs details.

methods.name: testcase_update
methods.description: Handles test case update event; logs details.

methods.name: testrequirement_create
methods.description: Handles test requirement creation; logs details.

methods.name: testrequirement_update
methods.description: Handles test requirement update; logs details.

methods.name: testrequirement_delete
methods.description: Handles test requirement deletion; logs details.

methods.name: testExecute
methods.description: Handles test execution event; logs test run details.

methods.name: testrun_display_block
methods.description: Returns an HTML image for test run display.
